english.title: Refuse / neglect / fail to comply with a direction imposed under the Road Traffic (Foreign Vehicles) Act 1972
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), refused, neglected or failed to comply within a reasonable time with a direction, namely **(..SPECIFY..), imposed under section 1(4) of the Road Traffic (Foreign Vehicles) Act 1972
english.legislation: Contrary to section 3(1)(c) of the Road Traffic (Foreign Vehicles) Act 1972.

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant refused, neglected or failed to comply within a reasonable time with a direction given by an authorised inspector or examiner.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Fixed penalty ticket - Three hundred pounds.
Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
